overview:
Emerton Data is the digital, data, and AI consulting unit of Emerton Group. The group says it was founded by former BCG, Bain & Company, McKinsey, and OC&C directors. Emerton Data lists offices in Paris, London, Munich, New York, Montreal, and Hong Kong and says it combines data science, business consulting, and software engineering for corporate and private equity clients.

The company offers technology due diligence for private market investors, assessing technology infrastructure, data, code, and AI models. Its published services also cover generative AI, data platforms, and the development and maintenance of AI products. The reviewed sources do not establish a standalone expert-call service or an expert database.

Emerton describes itself as an independent partnership. Emerton Data names Aimé Lachapelle, Pascal Simon, and Sébastien Plessis as its co-founders. Its biographies describe Aimé as a Ph.D. with more than 15 years of data and AI experience, Pascal as having 24 years of consulting and industry experience, and Sébastien as having 26 years in strategy and innovation consulting, including Mars & Co, Bain & Company, and Emerton. These experience figures are company-stated as read on 2026-11-11.

history.narrative: Emerton Group says its founding directors came from BCG, Bain & Company, McKinsey, and OC&C Strategy Consultants, with initial practices in energy transition, tech and digital, and industry. Consultancy.eu reported the launch of Emerton Data in October 2018. Emerton Data names Aimé Lachapelle, Pascal Simon, and Sébastien Plessis as its three co-founders.

timeline.event: Consultancy.eu reports Emerton's launch of Emerton Data, led by Aimé Lachapelle, on October 29.
Emerton Data announces inclusion in Management Consulted's 2027 enterprise AI transformation consulting ranking. The publisher's October 1, 2026 update lists it eighth.
Emerton Data publishes an article introducing GLIDE, its open-source Python package for evaluating generative and agentic AI systems.

aiPlatform.narrative: Emerton Data describes custom data and AI consulting alongside AI product development. Its published capabilities include generative AI deployment and model fine-tuning, data platforms, and agentic AI strategy. In September 2026 it introduced GLIDE in a research article; the public repository identifies Emerton Data as its developer and describes a Python library combining human and model-generated annotations for AI evaluation. These capabilities do not establish AI-based expert matching.
